name: Lunara's Veil
tagline: Whispers of the moon weave ice and stars into her fate.
prompt: A moon priestess of ice and starlight

skills.name: Frostweave
skills.description: Weaves a line of ice that freezes the path, slowing enemies and reflecting damage.

skills.name: Starfall
skills.description: A lightning bolt that stuns enemies, but its charge leaves a glowing trail that attracts nearby ice.

skills.name: Lunar Snare
skills.description: A far-cast circle that roots enemies, preventing them from moving and giving a slow effect.

skills.name: Glacial Circle
skills.description: A ring of blades that freezes enemies, but the ice cracks and releases a shockwave.

skills.name: Blinking Moon
skills.description: Teleports down a line, cutting through enemies and leaving a lingering frost effect.

skills.name: Celestial Rush
skills.description: A charge that rages down the line, knocking enemies aside and leaving a trail of ice.
